corrections.why: 12.2 m (40 ft) is the 1935 wooden tower. The steel tower that stood from 1966 until 1981 was 52 ft, about 15.8 m.
Idaho Fire Lookouts gives '1981 – Removed / Gone' and firelookout.com gives 'Gone 1981'. No page read gives 1999; the 1999 entry looks like an import error from the idaho_fl record.
Footings remain at the summit picnic table (WillhiteWeb, 2024). 'Ruins' is the status for footings or remains only.
The summit is inside McCroskey State Park.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Brief's 12.2 m matches the 40 ft 1935 wooden tower. Sources give 52 ft for the 1966 steel tower, which stood until 1981; 15.8 m used.
Brief's 1999 abandonment conflicts with 1981 removal on both Idaho Fire Lookouts and firelookout.com. 1981 used.

notes_for_editor: Proposed, not applied: status gone to ruins; ownership to state; height 12.2 to 15.8 m; 1999 event to 1981. Left out: Potlatch Historical Society photo phs1702 (uidaho.edu, date approximate, ~1960, caption says a steel tower later replaced the wooden one); no image URL recorded, so no photo added. WillhiteWeb reports names dated 1940 on the footings and calls this different from the history; kept in the story as a reported disagreement, not verified. Staffing: two entries on the Idaho Fire Lookouts page, 1961 Bert Watkins and 1970 Becker (name given only as Becker). Story corrected to match on 2026-10-10.
